description: The Feywood's canonical bioluminescent understory fungus, visible even in daylight at the Border. Hearthlight brightness correlates with ambient-field strength and serves as the primary visible indicator of Feywood health. Its dimming is one of the earliest visible Turning signals; its steady glow under Standing Green provides ambient illumination under heavy canopy.

ecology.cultural_role: primary visible health-register indicator; ambient illumination

name: Hearthlight Fungus
